decisions.P-C-AC-14: passed at runtime for CW-06 scope: original OMP keys/commands work through the product UI in both panes (slash commands, composer editing, autocomplete Esc, Ctrl-C, prefix literal; Esc aborts a running tool command visibly). Approval-prompt interaction is not applicable on the user's OMP configuration (no approval prompt for the shell tool); recorded as an unknown for CW-16 I-COMPAT rather than forcing a settings change (settings changes are prohibited).
decisions.running_child_assertion: The failing 'running child seen' assertion in tests/ui/live_product_rerun_independent_p27e.py checks OMP-internal tool execution (a process child of OMP), which is outside CW-06 criteria (UI key fidelity). Test left unmodified; the live file is an opt-in real-model probe and is excluded from required suite runs; its failure is recorded, not treated as a CW-06 defect.
decisions.live_probe_hazard: tests/ui/live_product_*_independent*.py run real model turns by default when OMP is present and are matched by '*_independent.py' discovery. Required-suite commands must use pattern 'test_*.py'; future packets say so. Consider making model turns opt-in during a later test-maintenance delta (non-blocking).
